question: 36 heads the old join still decides with the page stem reader on (thick orange box = the head). On which of these, if any, can you yourself not tell which stem the boxed head belongs to?
verbatim: I don't understand the question.  Aside from tile 5 that is boxing an ff the rest are all easily seen as noteheads with stems...

answers.subject: glyph/4/1/7/4/18
answers.answer: the box is on an ff (a dynamic), not a notehead
all easily seen as noteheads with stems

ours: None of the 35 is a case a musician cannot read: the page reader has no excuse to decline any of them, and none is a missing convention. Tile 5: the old join writes a G4 eighth, plain, on ink that is a dynamic -- a false note written unmarked. Sean did not say which stem each head is on; that is still read from the print, not from this answer.
